name: MathSheetPress — Math Worksheet Generator with Proven Answer Keys: 14 Topic Generators, Zero Duplicates, Print-Ready PDF (Local)
description:
How do I generate math worksheets whose answer key was produced independently of the questions, so I can actually trust it? Most generators print the key from the same code that wrote the problems — one bug, and both are wrong in matching ways, which is worse than no key at all.
MathSheetPress builds every problem twice, two different ways:
- CONSTRUCTION: the generator picks the answer first, then builds the question around it.
- INDEPENDENT RE-SOLVE: before anything is printed, an expression evaluator re-reads each arithmetic problem from its printed text, equations are re-solved with exact Fraction algebra, and quadratics are re-factored by brute-force root search. The key is written from THIS solve.
- THE GATE: if the two paths disagree, the problem is rejected and regenerated. It never reaches your students.
- ZERO DUPLICATES across the whole book, guaranteed by construction, not by eyeballing.
14 topic generators in three bands — Arithmetic (multiplication, division, fraction addition, percent-of, order of operations), Pre-Algebra (integer operations, one- and two-step equations, proportions, exponents) and Algebra (two-sided linear equations, slope, factoring quadratics, 2x2 systems) — or Mixed for review packs. Pick a seed and the same book rebuilds identically, so re-issues and key regeneration are always in sync.
Output is a print-ready 8.5x11in PDF: name/date worksheet pages with real work space, then a compact answer key. Built for teachers, homeschoolers, tutors and worksheet sellers who need volume without proofreading every line.
VERIFIED, NOT VIBES
Acceptance run: 48-problem mixed book — 48/48 answers re-derived by the independent verifier, expression problems re-evaluated a third way with zero disagreements, and one deliberately corrupted key entry caught by the gate (exactly 1 flagged).
Desktop worksheet generators sell for $135 per subject and up. MathSheetPress is $29 once, proof included, 100% on your computer. Windows 10/11. A sample book is included.
